Abstract:

A repdigit is a number whose decimal representation consists of repeated instances of the same digit.&nbspAssociated Pell numbers form a specific recursive integer sequence. This work investigates when the&nbspproduct of two associated Pell numbers can be represented as a repdigit and when an associated Pell&nbspnumber can be expressed as the product of two repdigits. Using the Binet formula for associated&nbspPell numbers, explicit bounds are obtained for respective indices of these numbers. These bounds are&nbspfurther refined using lower bounds for linear forms in logarithms and the Baker&ndashDavenport reduction&nbspmethod. The results contribute to the study of exponential Diophantine equations involving different&nbsprecurrence sequences and repdigits.&nbsp

Keywords: Associated Pell number, Repdigit, Diophantine equation, Linear forms in&nbsplogarithms, Convergent of the continued fraction
